method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Veterans' Entitlements Act 1986, Compilation No. 199, compilation date 1 July 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 17, 2025 and Act No. 31, 2026 (register id C2026C00275, in 4 volumes), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03268.txt. No instrument brought in: the indexed pension rates, the Approved Guide ratings and the s 37AA determination are inputs or facts.

scope: From the veteran's seat (and the widow's or widower's for ss 13A, 30(1)): s 12AA (no new Part II, Part IV or s 111 claims from 1 July 2026); s 9A (injury or death under the MRCA, not the VEA); s 5QA (a veteran's pension age); s 7A(1)(a) (qualifying service, paragraphs (b)-(h) as one fact); ss 36(1)-(3), 37(1), (3)-(5) (eligibility for age and invalidity service pension, with the residence rule for Commonwealth and allied veterans); s 36B(1)-(2) (provisional commencement day); ss 22(2)-(4), 23(1)-(4), (3A), 24(1)-(4), (2A) (which rate of disability pension, and how much, the rates in force as inputs); ss 13A(1), (2), 30(1) (the war widow's or widower's pension without a claim, and its rate); s 54(5), (5A) (the period to report a change); ss 57, 57A, 135(5), 175(2) (review). Out: the service pension rate (Schedule 6 Rate Calculator, income and assets tests); partner service pension, income support supplement, veteran payment, pension bonus; ss 23(5)-(6), 24(5)-(6), 25, 25A, 26, 27, 115D; compensation offsets; the dependant child rate; Parts IV-VIA; the Veterans' Review Board's procedure (MRCA Chapter 8); information, offences and machinery.
seat: the veteran; and, for ss 13A and 30(1), the veteran's widow or widower
